_doc.zh: 皮节图定义。种子为体表标志连成的曲线（见 landmarks.json / README.md）；标签自种子沿皮肤表面按测地距离扩散，左右两侧分别计算，不越过屏障线。修改种子只需改本文件，无需改代码。
_doc.en: Dermatome map definition. Seeds are landmark curves (see landmarks.json / README.md); labels spread from the seeds by geodesic distance on the skin, each side separately, never across a barrier. Edit seeds here; no code change is needed.

primary.zh: 以 ISNCSCI 关键感觉点（2011 年修订版）为锚点；关键点之间各区的排列，在 ISNCSCI 评定表图示所画出的部位（躯干和四肢前面、下肢后面）依该图，其余部位（躯干后面、上肢后面、手指）参照 Lee、McPhee 和 Stringer（2008）。Lee 等因变异大而留白的区域，由最近的已设种子皮节填充。
primary.en: ISNCSCI key sensory points (2011 revision) as anchors; arrangement of the areas between them as on the ISNCSCI worksheet figure where it shows the body (front of trunk and limbs, back of lower limb), and after Lee, McPhee & Stringer 2008 elsewhere (posterior trunk, back of arm, digits). Areas that Lee et al. leave blank as highly variable are filled by the nearest seeded dermatome.

deviations.zh: T3–T11 关键点取本模型第 n 肋间神经的体表投影与锁骨中线的交点（2011 年版定义为“第 n 肋间隙”）；括注的体表平面（T6 剑胸结合、T10 脐）只作报告，不强制对齐。
deviations.en: T3-T11 key points are taken where the skin projection of this body's nth intercostal nerve crosses the midclavicular line (the 2011 definition is 'nth intercostal space'); the parenthetical surface levels (xiphisternum for T6, umbilicus for T10) are reported, not enforced.

deviations.zh: S4 与 S5 合为一区（ISNCSCI 将 S4–5 作为一个平面检查）。
deviations.en: S4 and S5 are one region (ISNCSCI tests S4-5 as one level).

deviations.zh: 未表示相邻皮节之间的重叠；每个皮肤顶点只有一个标签。
deviations.en: Overlap between neighbouring dermatomes is not represented; each skin vertex has exactly one label.

barriers.name: ventral axial line of upper limb

note.zh: C4/C5/C6 与 T2/T1/C8 直接相邻，中间节段缺如
note.en: C4/C5/C6 meet T2/T1/C8 without the intervening segments

barriers.name: dorsal axial line of upper limb

note.zh: 肩后和臂后 C4/C5 与 T2/T1 直接相邻
note.en: C4/C5 meet T2/T1 on the back of the shoulder and arm

barriers.name: ventral axial line of lower limb

note.zh: 股内侧和小腿内侧 L1–L4 与 S3/S2 直接相邻
note.en: L1-L4 meet S3/S2 on the medial thigh and leg

barriers.name: dorsal axial line of lower limb

note.zh: 股后外侧 L2/L3 与 S2 直接相邻
note.en: L2/L3 meet S2 on the posterolateral thigh

rule.zh: 额部、上睑、鼻背和鼻尖，头皮向后约至颅顶。
rule.en: Forehead, upper eyelid, dorsum and tip of nose, scalp back to about the vertex.

note.zh: 额部至头皮前部，未达颅顶
note.en: forehead to the anterior scalp, short of the vertex
dorsum to tip of nose (external nasal branch)

rule.zh: 下睑、鼻侧、颊部、上唇、颞部前份。
rule.en: Lower eyelid, side of nose, cheek, upper lip, anterior temple.

note.en: lower eyelid, cheek beside the nose, upper lip
prominence of the cheek, anterior temple

rule.zh: 下唇、颏部、下颌骨表面皮肤（下颌角除外）、耳前至颞部的条带。
rule.en: Lower lip, chin, skin over the mandible except its angle, strip in front of the ear to the temple.

note.zh: 下唇、颏部、下颌体（不含下颌角）
note.en: lower lip, chin, body of mandible (not its angle)

note.zh: 耳前向上至颞部（耳颞神经）
note.en: in front of the ear and up the temple (auriculotemporal)

keyPoint.zh: 枕外隆凸外侧至少 1 cm 处。
keyPoint.en: At least 1 cm lateral to the external occipital protuberance.

rule.zh: 枕部至颅顶、耳后、下颌角。
rule.en: Occiput to the vertex, behind the ear, angle of the mandible.

note.en: behind the ear down to the angle of the mandible

keyPoint.zh: 锁骨中线上的锁骨上窝。
keyPoint.en: Supraclavicular fossa at the midclavicular line.

rule.zh: 颈前、颈后，向前延至下颌下方。
rule.en: Neck, front and back, forward under the mandible.

keyPoint.zh: 肩锁关节表面。
keyPoint.en: Over the acromioclavicular joint.

rule.zh: 披肩区：颈下部、肩顶、胸上部约至第 2 肋。
rule.en: Shoulder cape: lower neck, top of shoulder, upper chest to about the second rib.

note.en: back of the shoulder above the spine of the scapula
below the clavicle to the manubrium

keyPoint.zh: 肘窝外侧（桡侧），肘横纹近侧。
keyPoint.en: Lateral side of the antecubital fossa just proximal to the elbow crease.

rule.zh: 臂外侧。
rule.en: Lateral arm.

note.en: lateral arm from the deltoid to the elbow

keyPoint.zh: 拇指近节指骨背面。
keyPoint.en: Dorsal surface of the proximal phalanx of the thumb.

rule.zh: 前臂桡侧、拇指。
rule.en: Radial side of forearm, thumb.

note.zh: 前臂前外侧、鱼际、拇指掌面
note.en: anterolateral forearm, thenar eminence, palmar thumb

keyPoint.zh: 中指近节指骨背面。
keyPoint.en: Dorsal surface of the proximal phalanx of the middle finger.

rule.zh: 中指、手中部、前臂后面的条带；示指和环指归于 C6/C7/C8 中距离最近者。
rule.en: Middle finger, centre of hand, strip on the back of the forearm; index and ring fingers are left to the nearest of C6/C7/C8.

note.zh: 前臂后面向上的条带（推定；评定表图示未画上肢后面）
note.en: strip up the back of the forearm (interpolated; the worksheet figure does not show the back of the arm)

keyPoint.zh: 小指近节指骨背面。
keyPoint.en: Dorsal surface of the proximal phalanx of the little finger.

rule.zh: 小指、手尺侧缘和前臂远端尺侧。
rule.en: Little finger, ulnar border of hand and distal forearm.

keyPoint.zh: 肘窝内侧（尺侧），肱骨内上髁近侧。
keyPoint.en: Medial side of the antecubital fossa just proximal to the medial epicondyle.

rule.zh: 前臂内侧和臂内侧远段。
rule.en: Medial forearm and distal medial arm.

keyPoint.zh: 腋窝顶。
keyPoint.en: Apex of the axilla.

rule.zh: 第 2 肋间神经带、腋窝、臂内侧上部。
rule.en: Band of the 2nd intercostal nerve, axilla, upper medial arm.

note.zh: 沿第 2 肋间神经的条带；背部按其平面水平延至中线
note.en: band over the second intercostal nerve; level on the back carried straight to the midline

note.zh: 腋窝和臂内侧上部（肋间臂神经）

keyPoint.zh: 锁骨中线第 3 肋间隙；取本模型该肋间神经的体表投影与锁骨中线的交点。
keyPoint.en: Midclavicular line in the third intercostal space; taken where the skin projection of this body's intercostal nerve crosses the midclavicular line.

rule.zh: 沿肋间神经环绕躯干的条带。
rule.en: Band following the intercostal nerve round the trunk.

note.zh: 沿第 3 肋间神经的条带；肋角以内按其平面水平延至中线（属后支分布区，无对应的建模神经）
note.en: band over the third intercostal nerve; medial to the angle of the ribs its level is carried straight to the midline (dorsal ramus territory, no modelled nerve)

keyPoint.zh: 锁骨中线第 4 肋间隙（乳头平面）；取本模型该肋间神经的体表投影与锁骨中线的交点。
keyPoint.en: Midclavicular line in the fourth (nipple line) intercostal space; taken where the skin projection of this body's intercostal nerve crosses the midclavicular line.

rule.en: Band following the intercostal nerve round the trunk.

note.en: band over the fourth intercostal nerve; medial to the angle of the ribs its level is carried straight to the midline (dorsal ramus territory, no modelled nerve)

keyPoint.en: Midclavicular line in the fifth intercostal space; taken where the skin projection of this body's intercostal nerve crosses the midclavicular line.

keyPoint.en: Midclavicular line in the sixth (level of the xiphisternum) intercostal space; taken where the skin projection of this body's intercostal nerve crosses the midclavicular line.

keyPoint.en: Midclavicular line in the tenth (umbilicus) intercostal space; taken where the skin projection of this body's intercostal nerve crosses the midclavicular line.

rule.en: Band following the intercostal nerve round the trunk.

keyPoint.zh: 腹股沟韧带中点。
keyPoint.en: Midpoint of the inguinal ligament.

rule.zh: 髂嵴上方、沿腹股沟韧带至耻骨上方的条带（体表标志规则；模型中无肋下神经）。
rule.en: Band above the iliac crest and along the inguinal ligament to above the pubis (landmark rule; subcostal nerve not modelled).

note.zh: 模型中无肋下神经：自 T12 棘突经髂嵴上方至腹股沟韧带的连线
note.en: no subcostal nerve in the model: line from the T12 spinous process above the iliac crest to the inguinal ligament

keyPoint.zh: T12 与 L2 关键点连线的中点。
keyPoint.en: Midway between the T12 and L2 key points.

rule.zh: 腹股沟和股最上部，绕髋至 L1 棘突。
rule.en: Groin and uppermost thigh, round the hip to the L1 spinous process.

note.zh: 腰部、髋部、腹股沟韧带下方
note.en: loin, over the hip, groin below the inguinal ligament

keyPoint.zh: 股前内侧，腹股沟韧带中点与股骨内侧髁连线的中点。
keyPoint.en: Anterior-medial thigh, midpoint of the line from the mid-inguinal point to the medial femoral condyle.

rule.zh: 斜跨股前面上、中部的条带。
rule.en: Oblique band across the upper/mid anterior thigh.

note.en: upper buttock, obliquely across the front of the thigh

keyPoint.zh: 膝上方股骨内侧髁处。
keyPoint.en: Medial femoral condyle above the knee.

rule.zh: 股前面下部至膝内侧。
rule.en: Lower anterior thigh to the medial side of the knee.

note.en: lateral thigh obliquely to the medial knee

keyPoint.zh: 内踝。
keyPoint.en: Medial malleolus.

rule.zh: 膝前、小腿内侧、足内侧缘至第 1 跖骨底。
rule.en: Front of knee, medial leg, medial border of the foot to the base of the first metatarsal.

note.zh: 膝、小腿内侧、内踝、足内侧缘
note.en: knee, medial leg, medial malleolus, medial border of the foot

keyPoint.zh: 足背第 3 跖趾关节处。
keyPoint.en: Dorsum of the foot at the third metatarsophalangeal joint.

rule.zh: 小腿前外侧、足背、第 1–3 趾、足底前内侧。
rule.en: Anterolateral leg, dorsum of foot, great to third toes, medial forefoot of the sole.

note.en: anterolateral leg to the dorsum of the foot
great toe and ball of foot, plantar

keyPoint.zh: 足跟外侧（跟骨）。
keyPoint.en: Lateral heel (calcaneus).

rule.zh: 小腿后外侧下部、足跟、足外侧和足底外侧、第 4 趾和小趾。
rule.en: Lower posterolateral calf, heel, lateral foot and sole, fourth and little toes.

note.zh: 小腿后外侧下部、足跟外侧、足外侧缘、小趾
note.en: posterolateral lower calf, lateral heel, lateral border of foot, little toe

keyPoint.zh: 腘窝中点。
keyPoint.en: Midpoint of the popliteal fossa.

rule.zh: 股后面、腘窝，向下至小腿后面中线。
rule.en: Posterior thigh and popliteal fossa down the middle of the calf.

note.zh: 股后面、腘窝、小腿后面上部中线
note.en: back of thigh, popliteal fossa, upper mid-calf

keyPoint.zh: 坐骨结节或臀沟处。
keyPoint.en: Ischial tuberosity or infragluteal fold.

rule.zh: 臀内侧、会阴和外生殖器（与 S4–5 共同支配）；骶骨表面皮肤为推定归入本区。
rule.en: Medial buttock, perineum and external genitalia (with S4-5); skin over the sacrum is assigned here by interpolation.

note.en: over the sacrum, medial buttock, infragluteal fold

keyPoint.zh: 肛周皮肤黏膜交界外侧 1 cm 以内（作为一个平面）。
keyPoint.en: Perianal skin within 1 cm of the mucocutaneous junction (taken as one level).

rule.zh: 肛周皮肤和臀裂。
rule.en: Perianal skin and natal cleft.
